name: Neeco
source:
A devil in her 30s. She says she is engaged to [url=https://vndb.org/c113346]Yomi[/url].

She and Yomi explained that they had performed a demon summoning ritual, and in the dream of trials she begged to kill Ikenie, but...?

[Translated from [url=https://romankessha.wixsite.com/sadisma]official website[/url]]
